## About
Dan's Irish Sports Bar sits on Civic Dr in Walnut Creek. It's a bar first, with trivia nights, live music, pool tables and outdoor seating to round out the night.
One reviewer called it a Walnut Creek institution, and another described a family vibe where the bartenders and the regulars know each other by name. Dan's has a 4 rating on Google from 415 reviews.
Planning a party? You can rent the whole bar or just the pool room area for a private event. Sign up for the mailing list to get weekly updates on who's playing.

## Services
- Live music: Live music on some nights, plus pool tables any time. Check the calendar on the website for upcoming shows.
- Trivia nights and outdoor seating: Trivia nights for something different, plus outdoor seating when you want some air.
- Parties and private events: Book the bar for a party or private event. Fill out the rental form on the website with your date, hours and type of event.

## FAQ
Q: Is Dan's open to all ages?
A: No. Dan's is a 21+ venue at all times, and that includes band members and their families and friends.

Q: Do you serve food?
A: One reviewer noted that the bar doesn't offer food anymore, but you're welcome to bring your own.

Q: How do I book my band to play?
A: Please use the booking form on the website instead of calling the bar. The booking manager will reach out if they're interested.
